checks.class_mapping: D00: 0, D10: 1, D20: 2, D40: 3 (Matches official label_map.pbtxt)
checks.source_licensing: VERIFIED (CC BY 4.0, commercial use permitted with attribution)

road_damage_detection.justification: The official Figshare repository bundles all global subsets into a single 12.65 GB archive. Selective download of the India subset alone is not provided by the upstream host. In accordance with offline constraints, automated bulk downloading of 12.65 GB is halted until manual disk staging.
road_damage_detection.production_action: civicmodel.pt preserved in production; zero modifications applied.

checks.annotation_correctness: Forensically reconciled; 9 disputed catalog normals reclassified to blocked/damaged
checks.class_imbalance: CRITICAL FLAW: 50 damaged, 49 blocked, only 6 normal drains (5.8% normal)
checks.duplicate_detection: Detected 4 exact duplicate clusters (8 physical files on disk)
checks.train_val_leakage: Deduplication manifest isolates duplicate files from splits
checks.expansion_quota: Failed quota: 0 of 100 required additional normal drain images provided

drainage_condition_classification.justification: Severe normal-class starvation. With only 6 verified normal drains, training a multi-class model will induce extreme false-positive bias, incorrectly flagging clean drains as damaged or blocked. Retraining is strictly halted.
drainage_condition_classification.production_action: drainage_model.pt preserved in production; candidate drainage_model_v2.pt remains in experimental adapter only.

solid_waste_classification.target_model_type: 6-Class Object Detection (BIODEGRADABLE, CARDBOARD, GLASS, METAL, PAPER, PLASTIC)

checks.annotation_correctness: Labels present in YOLO format, but extreme sparsity
checks.bounding_box_validity: Valid normalized [x, y, w, h] boxes
checks.class_imbalance: CRITICAL FLAW: PLASTIC comprises 63.6% of annotations. CARDBOARD has only 1 training box.
checks.train_val_leakage: CRITICAL FLAW: Validation split has ZERO instances for 5 out of 6 classes (only PLASTIC represented). Test split has 0 instances for CARDBOARD.
checks.expansion_quota: Insufficient volume across all non-plastic classes

solid_waste_classification.justification: Mathematically incapable of computing validation mAP for 5 out of 6 classes during training. Training under these conditions produces an unusable detector. Retraining is strictly prohibited.
solid_waste_classification.production_action: best.pt preserved in production; zero modifications applied.
